verdict.rationale: Community reports confirm Llama models appear on the independent LMArena leaderboard, including Llama 1-derived models and Llama 4 Maverick. However, Meta's own materials show the Maverick entry was an experimental chat variant 'optimized for conversationality', which undermines how well the independent ranking reflects the released model. The other benchmark mentions in the pack are vendor-included numbers. Missing for 10: first-party or independent documentation of third-party evaluation coverage beyond LMArena, independent results matching the released weights, and evidence of presence on other leaderboards or eval suites.

support.subject: As a founder, the model shows up in independent third-party evaluations and leaderboards, so I am not relying only on vendor-run numbers

citations.quote: Llama 1 derived models on LMArena were beating gpt 3.5 by having less refusals.
it deployed an 'experimental chat version' of Maverick to LMArena that was specifically 'optimized for conversationality'
